step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows Ticketmaster's checkout platform. User requests come into a CDN layer (CloudFront). From the CDN, page rendering traffic is routed to Next.js running on Amazon EKS. API traffic is routed to AWS AppSync. Quick, single-step data operations go from AppSync to AWS Lambda, which interacts with Amazon DynamoDB. Complex, multi-step operations like checkout purchase workflows are orchestrated by AWS Step Functions. Amazon DynamoDB uses Global Tables to replicate data across multiple active-active AWS regions.
